headline: Earnings per share fall on last quarter, top last year
summary_short: EPS was CAD 0.13, down 43.0% from CAD 0.22 in the prior quarter and a swing from a loss of CAD 0.04 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It fell 43.0% q/q but turned positive from a small loss a year earlier. The latest company release found covers Q2 2026, with net debt of CAD 242.1M. No Q3 release was found, so no drivers or guidance are assessed.
